statements.impact_statement: OpenTelemetry-Go (sdk, sdk/log, trace) ships inside Redpanda Connect, but the sbom-hook deployment configures no tracer, no OpenTelemetry exporter and no attribute value length limit (k8s/infra/security-system/sbom-hook/redpanda-connect.yaml; started with --disable-telemetry). The truncation paths are only used when AttributeValueLengthLimit is set, and the only input is the Trivy operator webhook inside the cluster, so no attacker-controlled telemetry attributes reach the SDK.
